title: Tinyland Spoke lanes.json
description: Normative schema for .github/lanes.json in any repo spawned from tinyland-inc/site.scaffold. Source of truth for per-spoke CI lane metadata and Flywheel target-class binding. It grants no receiver, apply, DNS, or lifecycle authority. See docs/CI-SCHEMA.md for the full contract.

$schema.description: Editor support hint pointing at this schema. Tolerated; ignored by the validator.

$comment.description: Free-form comment. Tolerated; ignored by the validator.

schema_version.description: Schema major version. Bumped on breaking changes; migration notes in docs/CI-SCHEMA-CHANGELOG.md.

name.description: Spoke slug used by CI, artifact metadata, and owner-defined lifecycle consumers.

domain.description: Spoke brand domain metadata. Any QA hostname or DNS lifecycle is defined and owned outside this scaffold.

image_repository.description: Optional GHCR repository metadata for product-owned build or QA consumers. It grants no publication or deployment authority.

defaults.description: Per-lane field defaults. Each lane may override.

ttl_hours.description: Compatibility TTL hint for an owner-defined QA consumer. It is inert in this scaffold and creates no reaper or retention policy.

image_tag_template.description: Compatibility artifact-tag metadata for an owner-defined QA consumer. Tokens: {PR_NUMBER}, {COMMIT_SHA}, {LANE}.

flywheel_target_classes.description: Proved REAPI target classes the spoke may invoke through GF_BAZEL_SUBSTRATE_MODE=executor-backed. Must be a subset of the allowlist enum. See docs/CI-SCHEMA.md §4.

runnerClass.description: GitHub Actions runs-on label. Cluster classes require runner-pool ACL grant via tinyland-infra/modules/spoke/runner-binding. `ubuntu-latest` is permitted only for jobs whose entire purpose is a `gh api` call.

laneTrigger.description: Compatibility classification for build or QA consumers. It is metadata only and does not provision, converge, or reap an environment.

provedTargetClass.description: Mirrors tinyland-inc/GloriousFlywheel/config/rbe-target-eligibility.json at the tag this schema was cut against. `web-playwright-chromium-static-smoke` is candidate-status and will be rejected at runtime until promoted in a future schema bump.

name.description: Lane slug used by CI matrices and optional owner-defined QA consumers. It grants no DNS, status-publication, or state authority.

domain.description: Optional hostname metadata for an owner-defined QA consumer. This scaffold defines no default route or DNS mutation.

theme.description: Brand theme key, typically under src/lib/styles/themes/, consumed by product-owned build or QA tooling.

snapshot_source.description: Projection or broker-display source identifier. Examples: `tinyland://pulse/m1`, `checked-in`, `broker:/projections/jesssullivan-github-io/blog/broker-stream.v1.json`, or a full URL.

e2e.description: If true, a product-owned QA consumer may include this lane in its E2E matrix. No runner, route, or environment is implied.

ttl_hours.description: Per-lane compatibility TTL hint for an owner-defined QA consumer; inert unless that owner adopts it explicitly.

tofu_state_suffix.description: Legacy state-suffix hint retained for schema compatibility. The product owner defines the full state identity; this field creates no state or apply authority.

flywheel_target_classes.description: Per-lane proved REAPI target class allowlist. Must be a subset of defaults.flywheel_target_classes if both are set.

extra.description: Free-form lane-specific metadata for product-owned build or QA tooling. Must be JSON-serializable and carries no apply authority.
